target: scaffold.sh stamp — writing a stamp makes a matching tree report ok, and integrity catches a later edit
cmd: source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/scaffold.sh"; source "$FIXTURES/scaffold-fixture.sh"; export SCAFFOLD_STAMP_PATH=scripts/.agentic-scaffold.json; scaffold_fake_plugin fake 0.9.0; scaffold_put fake/scripts/lib/tracker.sh SAME; scaffold_put scripts/lib/tracker.sh SAME; scaffold_write_stamp fake software-interviewed fixture-src; BEFORE=$(scaffold_integrity | wc -l | tr -d ' '); scaffold_put scripts/lib/tracker.sh EDITED; AFTER=$(scaffold_integrity); jq -n --arg v "$(scaffold_field plugin_version)" --arg t "$(scaffold_field project_type)" --arg s "$(scaffold_field source)" --arg before "$BEFORE" --arg after "$AFTER" '{version: $v, type: $t, source: $s, before: $before, after: $after}'
